diagnostics.message: :module.forge_trust_validator_lambda: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.forge_trust_validator_lambda is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_cloudwatch_event_target.forge_trust_validator_lambda: explicit depends_on of :module.forge_trust_validator_lambda is redundant — already implied by attribute references
The module already has an implicit dependency on the log group through its `logging_log_group` input, so the explicit `depends_on` duplicates that ordering.

The event target already depends implicitly on the Lambda module through its `arn = module.forge_trust_validator_lambda.lambda_function_arn` reference, so this explicit `depends_on` duplicates that dependency.

The provisioner updates each Forge role's trust policy to name the Lambda execution role as a principal. That principal must exist when AWS accepts the trust-policy update, so this resource must wait for the Lambda module to create its execution role; currently it can run concurrently with the module.
